cards.title: Prepare to leave {from.area} {from.block}
instructions: Exit by climbing or descending to a transition layer within the area, through an unoccupied area (coordinate on Foxtrot Common · UHF CH 22), or laterally
Avoid North Mustang (6,500–17,500' MSL) at all times
Minimum altitude over the Aransas Wildlife Refuge is 3,000' AGL
cards.detail: Proceeding north instead? Contact Houston Center · UHF CH 23 and request flight following. Houston Center will not provide it without an explicit request. Make a courtesy call to IFR traffic on Houston Center · UHF CH 22 as needed.
cards.source: Binder, p. 28; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 96.

cards.title: Announce your departure on Foxtrot Common

exchange.speaker: Approach
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Approach, roger, proceed as requested.
